text:
My experience with this clinic for orthodontic treatment has been unsatisfactory.
The reception staff lacks warmth and a welcoming smile, and the area around the counter is dimly lit and uncomfortable. The dentist seemed rushed during the sessions and handled my teeth with noticeable roughness.
Despite booking the appointment a month in advance and informing them that this was the only suitable day for both my schedule and the dentist’s, the appointment was not confirmed a day before, as is customary, nor was I informed about the dentist’s absence.
I found this surprising and had to reach out myself, and yes they CONFIRMED my appointment. However, upon arriving, I was shocked to find that the dentist was absent, with no real apology or attention to the situation.

While I understand that mistakes can happen, the recurrence of these issues and the lack of professionalism in handling them has undermined my trust in the service.
The new staff member was respectful and courteous, and the dentist’s assistants were kind.
I tried the Air Flow treatment, and it was good . I also liked the color of the rubber band, number 25.
I also appreciate the cleaning staff for their hard work.

Overall, I hope the clinic improves communication and respect, particularly with patients undergoing long-term treatments like orthodontics, as consistency and professionalism play a key role in the patient experience and their trust in the service.

text: The admin informed that the last doctor will accept a case no later than 7 PM. We arrived at 5:20 PM and informed that we were doing Zoom teeth whitening. The staff called to tell me to go scrape off the tartar and wait. Huh?? Do they really think the time and feelings of the customers are worthless to that extent? They want me to wait, so they wait, tell me to go back, if I can't do it then I have to go back, and then they tell me to come back again tomorrow at 10 o'clock. It's very strange. I've never had to deal with this kind of confusing problem-solving and incompetence before. It's really bad. But the clinic looks clean and looks like a great place to do it.
